incident_input: Excavator boom lift is weak, main pressure is below target, and pump flow falls under load.
expected_safety_notes: Lower suspended loads before pressure testing.

incident_input: Mobile crane accumulator pressure decays after load-hold test and boom response is delayed.
expected_safety_notes: Depressurize and follow accumulator lockout procedure.

incident_input: Concrete pump delivery pressure fluctuates and cycle rate drops during high slump pour.
expected_safety_notes: Do not continue production at elevated temperature.

incident_input: Hydraulic press ram drifts during hold segment with no visible external leak.
expected_safety_notes: Support loads mechanically before isolation tests.

incident_input: Test rig supply pressure sensor disagrees with a calibrated reference gauge during calibration.
expected_safety_notes: Use mechanical gauges for safety-critical confirmation.

incident_input: Oil temperature exceeds limit and cooler delta temperature is low on excavator during trenching.
expected_safety_notes: Allow oil to cool before opening hydraulic lines.

incident_input: Crane control voltage drops during winch actuation and the controller resets intermittently.
expected_safety_notes: Unexpected valve dropout may cause load movement.

incident_input: Press cannot reach forming pressure and relief line heats quickly.
expected_safety_notes: Use calibrated test equipment and pressure-rated hoses.

incident_input: Test rig pump whines, flow becomes unstable, and inlet vacuum is elevated.
expected_safety_notes: Stop test if pump noise escalates rapidly.

incident_input: Return filter indicator activates after hammer attachment use and oil sample shows high particle count.
expected_safety_notes: Contain spilled oil during filter change.
